summary: Phase S1 blocked: nf_2var_from_interval_data bridge lemma requires EF game infrastructure for the NF world that does not exist in the codebase; simple induction on k is insufficient

blocking_issues.description: The bridge lemma proof requires a game-theoretic back-and-forth argument. Direct induction on k fails because the inductive step needs interval type data for sub-intervals involving new witness points, which cannot be derived from the hypotheses. Three resolution options documented in the plan BLOCKER entry (Option A: build NF-world game framework ~400-700 lines; Option B: strengthen hypotheses ~300-500 lines; Option C: restructure the formula ~200-400 lines).

continuation_context.recommended_action: Option A: Build simple EF game framework for NF world (nf_game_strategy + Fraisse theorem for nf_characteristic), then prove bridge lemma using game strategy from hypotheses
